content: llms.txt approaches: Fumadocs built-in (llms(source).index() route + remark-llms processed markdown per page, .md suffix routes); Starlight via starlight-llms-txt 0.11.0 community plugin; generic CLI llms-txt-generator. For Lyra, llms.txt is generated from hand-written .d.ts at build (custom script) and emitted to docs public/ — framework-agnostic; docs framework only needs to serve a static file.
